meta.title: feat: rewrite sitemap XML parsing from JavaScript to Rust (ENG-2904)
meta.body_summary: Replace JavaScript xml2js sitemap XML parsing with Rust roxmltree, add FFI wrapper, and gradually move post-processing logic to Rust through an instruction-based approach to improve performance.

perf_labels.notes: Devin rewrote sitemap parsing from JS to Rust; maintainer requested enum refactor, testing, fallback, and deeper logic migration; all addressed and PR merged after rapid iteration.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 604 changed lines across 5 files, this is a medium-sized edit by absolute volume, concentrated in the Rust FFI code and TypeScript wrapper. As a performance rewrite targeting XML parsing, it fits a moderate incremental change that merged after two rounds of iterative feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: mogery requested: 1) Add Rust unit tests using #[cfg::test], 2) Convert ParsedSitemap to an enum, 3) Fallback to JS parser on failure, 4) Move additional post-processing logic to Rust with an instruction-based API.
review_details.performance_claim: Improve performance of sitemap XML parsing by replacing JavaScript xml2js with Rust roxmltree.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cross-language FFI optimization with Rust/NAPI and instruction-based post-processing required careful design and iterative feedback; Devin handled the full rewrite, added tests, and moved logic progressively based on maintainer direction.

detection_detail.code_reading: mogery reviewed the Rust FFI code and requested specific improvements: enum refactor, testing, fallback, and additional logic migration.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR includes manual test checklist and Rust unit tests; no benchmark numbers, but performance validation checkbox was checked in the PR body.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All issues raised in review were addressed with new commits: fallback added, enum refactored, tests added, and post-processing logic migrated to Rust.

core_change_summary.description: Replaced JavaScript xml2js with Rust roxmltree for sitemap XML parsing in apps/api/sharedLibs/crawler/src/lib.rs, exposed via FFI wrapper in crawler.ts, and updated sitemap.ts to use Rust function; later moved additional post-processing logic to Rust with an instruction-based return to minimize JavaScript work.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Cargo files updated with new dependency; no functional changes to observability.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: Added roxmltree, implemented parse_sitemap_xml with FFI, wired into sitemap.ts replacing xml2js.
Refactor commit: Wrapped FFI calls following existing filterLinks pattern.
Feedback commit: Added Rust tests, converted ParsedSitemap to enum, added JS fallback on parse error.
Final commit: Extended Rust to handle post-processing with instruction-based approach, moved URL filtering and recursion decisions to Rust, added comprehensive fallback.
